consumer: An external graphing tool reading the exported snapshot's raw stored_kcal scalar to plot calorie history over time; it asks 'what is the avatar's true stored calorie count right now?', not a yes/no.
scope: the avatar's own raw stored_kcal scalar only (single character's authoritative state); no predicate evaluation and no reach beyond the avatar
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_avatar(scalars) — writes ctx.u.get_stored_kcal() straight from the engine getter into the snapshot JSON as raw state, alongside other scalars; it neither computes a yes/no nor formats a display view.
divergence: An avatar fed past the kcal_percent saturation cap: raw stored_kcal keeps climbing while the derived kcal_percent float plateaus — a wrong answer that exports kcal_percent (or any clamped/display proxy) would flatline the graph while true stored calories still rose, exposing it.
